I’m in on those terms: 15 tons this month, with the full $15,000 paid directly to the clinic, provided John joins us and Luke catches zero. My family taught me to look after both the lake and the neighbors who depend on it.

I’ll also keep to 6 tons next month and 10 thereafter only once the lake is back at 100 tons. If catches differ from our agreement, we’ll need to adjust the recovery limits to leave at least 50 tons in the water. I’ll share my catch total and donation receipt.

John, can you commit? Your agreement would complete the clinic’s funding.
